Name: Expressive
Description: Виразні бузкові тони й округлі кольорові поверхні.
StyleResources:
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:fx="clr-namespace:CategoryBar.Theming;assembly=CategoryBar">
<ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.WorkspaceTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
<Grid><Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
<ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Sidebar}" Margin="12,0,12,10" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
<ContentControl Grid.Row="1" Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Page}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"/>
</Grid></ControlTemplate>
<Style x:Key="Theme.NavigationPanel" TargetType="StackPanel"><Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal"/><Setter Property="Tag" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.navigation}"/><Setter Property="Margin" Value="8,6"/><Style.Triggers><Trigger Property="Tag" Value="left"><Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical"/></Trigger></Style.Triggers></Style>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Page.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.X)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Content.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="16" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.26"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><BackEase EasingMode="EaseOut" Amplitude="0.25"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.10"/><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" To="4" Duration="0:0:0.10"/></Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0.35" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/></Storyboard>
<ControlTemplate x:Key="Expressive.SidebarWorkspace" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface"><Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="208"/><ColumnDefinition/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
<ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Sidebar}" Margin="12,0,8,12" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
<ContentControl Grid.Column="1" Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Page}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"/>
</Grid></ControlTemplate>
<Style x:Key="Theme.Workspace" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface"><Setter Property="Template" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.WorkspaceTemplate}"/><Setter Property="Tag" Value="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.navigation}"/>
<Style.Triggers><Trigger Property="Tag" Value="left"><Setter Property="Template" Value="{DynamicResource Expressive.SidebarWorkspace}"/></Trigger></Style.Triggers></Style>
</ResourceDictionary>
